**AME – Adaptive Mix Exchange 1.3.0** · built by **Batze the bit builder** · *Every track finds its aim.*

A networked, adaptive channel strip (VST3 for Windows x64 and macOS, AU for macOS). Put AME on your tracks (**Line**) and one instance on the master bus (**Exchange**): the Exchange listens to all lines, detects masking and gives every track its place in the spectrum and in the level balance – continuously.

### What's new in 1.3.0
- **macOS**: VST3 and **AU** (Logic Pro, GarageBand, …), Universal Binary for Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or later
- Settings and user presets on macOS in `~/Library/Application Support/AME/`
- No changes to sound, parameters or projects on Windows

### Downloads
- `…-win64-vst3.zip` – Windows 64-bit, VST3
- `…-macos-vst3-au.zip` – macOS 11+, VST3 + AU

### macOS: first start
AME is ad-hoc signed but **not notarized** by Apple. After copying, remove the download quarantine once in Terminal – otherwise macOS reports the plug-in as damaged or unverifiable:
```sh
sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/AME Adaptive Mix Exchange.vst3"
sudo xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/AME Adaptive Mix Exchange.component"
```
The macOS build is new and has seen little testing in DAWs so far – feedback via Issues is welcome.

### Highlights
- Full channel strip per track: input, phase, HPF/LPF (12/24/48 dB), gate/expander, 4-band EQ (shelf/bell), compressor (knee, mix, SC-HPF, auto release), de-esser, saturation/exciter, width/pan, output, limiter/clipper
- Adaptive engine with 6 programs (Rock/Band, Pop, Electronic, Hip-Hop, Acoustic, Metal), roles, priority and response per track; only cuts, total level stays constant
- Auto role detection from track name and sound
- Exchange monitor: Full / No Engine / Raw with level match; Direct, Hold and Recording per track
- Factory presets per role, user presets, A/B compare
- Analyser, spectrogram, masking patchbay, VU meters; vintage UI in landscape format, foldable sections, scalable 50–200 %
- German/English interface, built-in manual (DE/EN)
- Instances find each other automatically, also across plug-in processes (shared-memory hub)

### Installation
1. Unzip and copy the plug-in:
   - Windows: `AME Adaptive Mix Exchange.vst3` to `C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\`
   - macOS: `.vst3` to `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/`, `.component` to `/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/Components/`, then remove the quarantine (see above)
2. Rescan plug-ins in your DAW. The vendor is **Batze the bit builder**.

Works in all common VST3 hosts on Windows 64-bit and macOS (e.g. Ableton Live, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper, Bitwig Studio, FL Studio) and as AU in Logic Pro; tested with Ableton Live on Windows.

The manual is inside the plug-in (**MANUAL** button) and in the `Manual` folder of the ZIP.

---

**Deutsch:** Vernetzter, adaptiver Channelstrip (VST3 für Windows und macOS, AU für macOS). AME auf die Spuren (**Line**), eine Instanz auf den Master (**Exchange**) – jede Spur bekommt ihren Platz im Mix. Installation wie oben, Handbuch im Plugin (**HANDBUCH**) und im ZIP.
